## What P33.6 did

Produced the **read-only stack/conflict inspection and the ordered integration +
rollback procedure** for the whole open PR stack, as an operator-facing artifact:
`docs/build/reports/p33.6-integration-plan/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`. This ticket ran no
mutating git/GitHub operation — only `gh pr list/view`, `git` inspection, throwaway
detached-worktree merge simulation under `/tmp`, and
`docs/build/tools/merge_dryrun.sh`.

1. **The PR graph (§(a))** — 75 OPEN PRs (#112–#187; #148 already MERGED) inventoried
   bottom-up with base/head/SHA/diffstat (+328,101/−9,509 across 3,495 file changes),
   plus the five seed bases that ride in transitively. `origin/main` =
   `3b913c6f` (PR #111 merge); the stack's effective fork is `5b7fed0e`; **`main`'s
   tree is byte-identical to the fork point's tree** (`d5b230f7…`) — main has moved
   but has not diverged content-wise. Local `main` is stale (pre-existing, §A.1).
2. **Merge-order dependencies (§(b))** — the five shared append-mostly files that
   make ascending order load-bearing: `db/sqitch.plan` (26 commits, pure `+27/−0`
   appends), `DEFERRALS.md` (86), `LEDGER.md` (120), `BUILD_INDEX.md` (85),
   `BACKLOG.{csv,md}`/`adr/README.md`/`spec_src` (~50 each).
3. **Real conflicts (§(c))** — twelve head branches carry one pushed tip commit no
   child was stacked on (10 byte-identical `web/package-lock.json` regens + 2
   DEFERRALS `(cites BL-056)` cell edits). Bottom-up accumulation simulation onto
   `origin/main`: conflicts at exactly **#113 and #117** (`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`)
   and **#155** (`web/package-lock.json` — the `@types/node` 26.6.2→26.6.3 delta,
   whose version the Round-10 chain's CI ran on); the accumulated final tree is
   **byte-identical to PR #187's head tree** (`51dcab80…`). `merge_dryrun.sh`:
   Pass A all-clean; Pass B stops at #113 as documented.
4. **Gates (§(d))** — chain completion (P33.6/7/8 PRs land first), no gate signed by
   merging, environment prerequisites, re-run the dry-run first.
5. **Procedure (§(e))** — ascending-order loop: `gh pr edit <N> --base main` then
   `gh pr merge <N> --merge --delete-branch=false`; the three conflict steps with the
   `git checkout --theirs` resolution per file; STOP on any undocumented conflict;
   verification cadence (`make check` after each resolution before push; segment
   pauses at the seed boundaries; full post-gate in §(h)).
6. **Rollback (§(f))** — `git merge --abort` pre-push; `git revert -m 1` in reverse
   merge order post-push (never reset/force-push); mid-run halt is safe; the
   SIG-TRUST-006 withdrawal invariant recorded for published bytes.
7. **Owed register carried forward (§(g))** — the deferred S3 spine

8. **Post-merge verification (§(h)) + reproduction (§(i))** — the tree-equality
   invariant against the top merged head, `make check` + `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`
